method: The first 15 rows of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order. The file holds 257 rows and every one is cve-pairs-php (the Python and JavaScript rows were noted in earlier runs), so this batch is PHP only. For each case I read the fix commit (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show source or sink, the files at the fix commit's parent: opnsense firewall_rules.php and firewall_rules_edit.php, LibreBooking ManageEmailTemplatesPresenter.php and ManageEmailTemplatesPage.php, CodeIgniter MY_Controller.php, Dolibarr api_setup.class.php, FrontAccounting rep601.php and rep710.php, grav AbstractApiController.php and PagesController.php, lms tarifflist.php and netdevxajax.inc.php, MISP UsersController.php and AppController.php, php-censor WebhookController.php / Builder.php / CommandExecutor.php, opensourcepos Items.php, OpenCATS lib/CATSUtility.php, and wp-downloadmanager wp-downloadmanager.php and download-options.php. No row was skipped. All notes are marked sure: source and sink are both visible in the diff or the fetched parent files. Five cases use a stored value (config, database, session or user setting) and three turn on a validator that was already present but too weak or the wrong one, so a rule needs the stored-value or validator path, not just a direct request-to-sink flow.

<?php
class TemplateEditor
{
    private $page;
    private $filesystem;

    public function update()
    {
        $name = $this->page->GetUpdatedTemplateName();
        $body = $this->page->GetTemplateContents();
        $dir = PATHS::EmailTemplates($this->page->GetUpdatedLanguage());
        return $this->filesystem->Save($dir, str_replace('.tpl', '-custom.tpl', $name), $body);
    }
}

notes.source: htdocs/api/class/api_setup.class.php:353 (fix parent): the $sqlfilters argument of getListOfRegions() (and getListOfIncoterms at :2514, getListOfVAT at :2579, api_multicurrencies.class.php:66), bound to the GET sqlfilters parameter of the dictionary list endpoints
notes.between: the only gate is DolibarrApi::_checkFilters(), which checks parenthesis balance and passes non-matching text through verbatim; a rule that takes _checkFilters as a sanitizer stops here; the fix sends the same parameter through forgeSQLFromUniversalSearchCriteria(), whose dummy-criteria syntax check rejects the leftover text
notes.fix: replaces _checkFilters() + bare preg_replace_callback with forgeSQLFromUniversalSearchCriteria() in the four endpoints
notes.probe:
<?php
$sqlfilters = $_GET['sqlfilters'];
$sql = 'SELECT rowid FROM ' . MAIN_DB_PREFIX . 'c_regions WHERE 1 = 1';
if ($sqlfilters) {
    if (!DolibarrApi::_checkFilters($sqlfilters, $err)) {
        throw new RestException(400, $err);
    }
    $re = '/\(([^:\'\(\)]+:[^:\'\(\)]+:[^\(\)]+)\)/';
    $sql .= ' AND (' . preg_replace_callback('/' . $re . '/', 'DolibarrApi::_forge_criteria_callback', $sqlfilters) . ')';
}
$db->query($sql);

<?php
function print_bank_transactions()
{

<?php

notes.source: modules/netdevxajax.inc.php:271 (fix parent): function getThroughput($ip) is an xajax action, so $ip is the argument the browser's JavaScript passes; modules/nodexajax.inc.php:219 registers the same function
notes.sink: netdevxajax.inc.php:276-280: $cmd = str_replace('%i', $ip, $cmd); exec($cmd, $output) - $cmd is the phpui.live_traffic_helper command template from the config
notes.between: the only guard is empty($cmd); the IP string is substituted into the configured shell command with no escaping and no check_ip(), so '; id' or a backtick runs on the server (the xajax response comes back to the same browser); the fix adds check_ip($ip) to the guard
notes.fix: adds check_ip($ip) to the empty($cmd) guard in both getThroughput() functions
notes.probe:
<?php
function getThroughput($ip)
{
    $cmd = ConfigHelper::getConfig('phpui.live_traffic_helper');
    if (empty($cmd)) {
        return '';
    }
    $cmd = str_replace('%i', $ip, $cmd);
    exec($cmd, $output);
    return $output[0] ?? '';
}

$xajax->registerFunction('getThroughput');

<?php
class GitBuild
{
    public function checkout($builder, $dir, $commitId)
    {
        $cmd = $dir . ' && git checkout %s --quiet';
        return $builder->executeCommand($cmd, $dir, $commitId);
    }
}

class Builder
{
    public function executeCommand(...$params)
    {
        $command = call_user_func_array('sprintf', $params);
        return Process::fromShellCommandline($command)->run();
    }
}

notes.source: app/Controllers/Items.php:153 (fix parent): the $pic_filename route parameter of getPicThumb(), rawurldecode()d at :157
notes.sink: Items.php:159 glob("./uploads/item_pics/$pic_filename") and :173-174 mime_content_type($thumb_path) / file_get_contents($thumb_path), where $thumb_path is built from the same name at :160-164
notes.between: the route segment is decoded and pasted into the glob pattern and the thumb path; glob() expands '..' and a wildcard, so a name like ../../.env or ../../app/Config/*.php selects files outside uploads/, and file_get_contents() returns the first match to the response
notes.fix: basename(rawurldecode($pic_filename)), lowercased extension checked against image_allowed_types, 400 otherwise
notes.probe:
<?php
class Items
{
    public function getPicThumb(string $pic_filename)
    {
        $pic_filename = rawurldecode($pic_filename);
        $file_extension = pathinfo($pic_filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        $images = glob('./uploads/item_pics/' . $pic_filename);
        $base_path = './uploads/item_pics/' . pathinfo($pic_filename, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
        if (sizeof($images) > 0) {
            $thumb_path = $base_path . '_thumb.' . $file_extension;
            $this->response->setBody(file_get_contents($thumb_path));
        }
        return $this->response;
    }
}

notes.probe:
<?php
function change_config_setting($name, $value)
{
    $new = [];
    foreach (file('config.php') as $line) {
        if (strpos($line, "define('" . $name . "'") === 0) {
            $new[] = sprintf("define('%s', %s);", $name, "'" . $value . "'");
        } else {
            $new[] = rtrim($line);
        }
    }
    file_put_contents('config.php', implode("\n", $new) . "\n");
}

change_config_setting('DATABASE_USER', $_REQUEST['user']);
